freezeAnchor.rule: A later validator must hard-pin the exact commit and UTC that adds this artifact. Only observations strictly later than that commit may enter the prospective survival ledger.

whyLatencyAgnostic: Choosing actionLatencySeconds after observing outcomes would create selection bias. Instead every complete passive cycle records the entire bounded post-GHT survival path without selecting a latency threshold. A later independently frozen latency may classify every retained cycle deterministically; cycles may not be selectively included or excluded based on that latency.

cycleMustContinueUntil: or the predeclared observation horizon ends

frozenOutputs.lastConfirmedUnawardedLagSeconds: latest retained state with unchanged winCount and nondecreasing amount, measured from GHT
frozenOutputs.firstObservedAwardOrResetLagSeconds: first retained state with changed winCount or decreased amount, if observed

laterDeterministicClassification.successAtLatencyL: cycle has confirmed unchanged/unreset state at or after detectionTimestamp + L
laterDeterministicClassification.failureAtLatencyL: award/reset is observed strictly before detectionTimestamp + L
laterDeterministicClassification.ambiguousAtLatencyL: observation gaps or censoring do not establish either condition

operatorRuleSeparation.reason: The passive server-state survival path is an observable property independent of whether bet365 legally/operationally adopts the provider first-bet-following-day rule. Rule adoption remains mandatory before translating survival into an executable first-bet race probability.
